name: cbox-brain
description: Cbox Brain, your team's shared memory, wired into Claude Code: the project's context at session start (and again after a compaction), what changed in Brain on every prompt, a gate before deploy-shaped commands against the team's policies, a reminder to remember at stop, and what was learned carried through a compaction. Connect the MCP server first (`claude mcp add --transport http cbox-brain https://app.cboxbrain.com/mcp`), then sign the hooks in with `node scripts/brain.mjs login`; opt out with BRAIN_HOOKS=off or a .brain-ignore file.
